about: The exception that each client library raises for the error pages in content/develop/reference/errors/common/, and what its message looks like. Keyed by page file name. Each client was run against a live server, with the same scenarios as build/errors/live_checks.py: redis-py as recorded in build/errors/live_baseline.json, and the others with build/errors/live_clients.py on redis:8.10 (server 8.10.2), in build/errors/client_baselines/. The notes on MOVED and ASK about cluster clients that follow the redirect come from source.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.note: The async API wraps the exception in an `ExecutionException` (`get()`) or a `CompletionException` (`join()`).

stackexchange-redis.name: StackExchange.Redis
stackexchange-redis.note: NRedisStack uses StackExchange.Redis, so it raises the same exceptions. The sync and async APIs raise the same exceptions.

redis-rs.name: redis-rs
redis-rs.note: The sync and async APIs raise the same errors.
